subject: Slow Sunday — Recipes, Reads, and One Small Upgrade
preheader: This issue: a citrus-forward brunch idea, a photo essay from the coast, and a kitchen tool our editors bought twice. Unwind with something beautiful—no hustle language, just calm weekend energy.

content.headline: Your slow Sunday starts here
content.subheadline: Food, place, and a little domestic joy—curated for readers who like their inboxes soft, not loud.

content.headline: Brunch: citrus + herbs
content.body: We tested a skillet cake that leans on cara cara oranges and a whisper of rosemary. It feeds a table of four without turning your morning into a project—mix the night before if you want an even softer start.
content.imagePrompt: [STOCK] Citrus fruit and rosemary sprigs on marble cutting board, overhead food photography, soft shadows
content.altText: Citrus and herbs arranged for brunch baking

content.headline: A coastal photo essay
content.body: Fog lifting off the pier, bikes leaned against weathered wood, and the sound of gulls mixed with espresso steam. We kept captions short so the images can breathe—tap through on the web version.
content.imagePrompt: [STOCK] Coastal boardwalk at golden hour, gentle waves, muted pastel sky, cinematic travel photography

content.quote: I read this on my phone in the garden. The recipes are practical and the photos feel human—not like an ad pretending to be a magazine.
